author: Rudeless
body:
Okay so here I am and I show myself. I am truly idozoslime; yes I used to hack. I admit it. When I was banned, I was hacking; I knew it was wrong but I still did it. I since then learned the consequences by having to play on other servers; I really want to play again. My Minecraft username at the time was idozoslime and I bought a new account for 20 euros at a German store just so I could play on this server. My old account username is CommanderSlime now and my new one is NativeSlime. I started to play on the server after I bought the new one, but I realized that that was ban evasion and I stopped playing to come here. I would like to recieve an unban for CommanderSlime and NativeSlime. I would just like a second chance. Thank you for veiwing this appeal and thanks to MLGPorky for helping!
-NativeSlime  (aka. CommanderSlime)
